# Datakraften — AI-Native Developer Workstation Bootstrap

> Datakraften (dk) bootstraps your entire developer workstation in one command.  
> WSL-first, opinionated, idempotent, and team-ready.

## What it does

`dk` is a CLI that orchestrates existing package managers (apt, brew, dnf, pacman), runtime version managers (fnm for Node, uv for Python), shell configuration (Fish + Starship + Atuin), editor detection (VS Code, Zed, Cursor), and AI tool setup — all from a single YAML config.

## Key features

- **One-command setup**: `curl -fsSL https://datakraften.no/install | bash && dk init && dk apply`
- **AI-native**: Installs and configures AI dev tools out of the box
- **Idempotent**: Safe to run `dk apply` repeatedly — only installs what's missing
- **Team-ready**: Share a remote YAML profile for consistent team environments
- **Diagnostics**: `dk doctor` checks system, tools, runtimes, editors, Docker, and shell
- **3 profiles**: `minimal` (bare essentials), `default` (full dev setup), `custom` (remote YAML)

## CLI commands

- `dk init` — Generate interactive config with profile selection
- `dk apply` — Install everything (packages, runtimes, shell, editors, AI tools)
- `dk doctor` — Run diagnostic checks across all categories
- `dk status` — Show installed tools and versions
- `dk profile list` — List available profiles
- `dk profile use <name>` — Switch profile
- `dk update` — Self-update the CLI

## Supported platforms

- **WSL** (primary target) — auto-detects WSL 2, systemd, Windows-side editors
- **Linux** — native Ubuntu/Debian, Fedora, Arch
- **macOS** — via Homebrew (partial support)

## Tooling provided

| Category | Tools |
|---|---|
| Shell | Fish, Starship prompt, Atuin history, fzf |
| Editors | VS Code, Zed, Cursor (with WSL-side detection) |
| Runtimes | Node (fnm), Python (uv), .NET |
| AI | GitHub Copilot CLI, aider, Continue.dev |
